figures.finding: Television writers in Japan who belong to the Writers Guild of Japan (日本脚本家連盟) are commissioned under collective agreements it holds with NHK and the commercial broadcasters' federation (民放連), separate ones for radio and television, which set the writing-contract terms, a minimum script fee and the fees for reruns; the fee for the first broadcast is included in the script fee.

value.union: 協同組合日本脚本家連盟 (Writers Guild of Japan)
counterparties: 日本民間放送連盟 (JBA, the commercial broadcasters' federation)
documents: ラジオ放送に関する団体協約書
テレビ放送に関する団体協約書
sets: a minimum script fee (最低脚本料)
value.noBuyout: members may not sign buy-out contracts

figures.applies: Japan, broadcast drama and radio scripts by Guild members (agreements listed in 2005, cited by the Guild in 2026).

sources.said: NHK・民放連と日脚連との間で結ばれている団体協約書に定める契約条件に従い、放送事業者と脚本家との間で執筆委嘱契約を結ぶこととなる。
脚本家に支払われる脚本料には当初の放送に関する使用料が含まれているため、日脚連は使用料を徴収しないが、番組を改めて再放送する際には、放送事業者は管理事業者である日脚連に利用の許諾を得て、団体協約に基づく使用料を支払うこととなる。
ラジオ放送に関する団体協約書
テレビ放送に関する団体協約書
脚本料が、ＮＨＫ、日本民間放送連盟その他との団体協約に定めた最低脚本料以上の方
買い取り契約を結ぶことはできません。

figures.finding: The Writers Guild of Japan's royalty scale for re-use of a TV programme's script is 4% of the sale price to the broadcaster for a terrestrial rerun (3.6% BS, 4% CS and cable), 1.75% of retail per copy for sale video, 3.35% for rental, 3.5% of the price to a streaming service when the rights holder pays (1.4% of the service's subscription and advertising income when it pays itself) and 3.5% of overseas sales; feature films pay 4% on every broadcast.

value.unit: royalty to the scriptwriter, % of the stated base, per use (guide, Guild tariff)
value.note: first broadcast is paid within the script fee

figures.applies: Japan, re-use of scripts by writers who have entrusted their copyright to the Guild, 2026.

figures.finding: The Writers Guild of Japan (協同組合日本脚本家連盟, Tokyo, founded 1 March 1966; 1,640 members and 2,505 copyright trustors in March 2026) admits writers with at least two published scripts paid at or above the collective agreements' minimum script fee; joining costs 10,000 yen (a 1,000-yen share, a 3,000-yen fee and six months' dues) and dues are 12,000 yen a year.

script fee at or above the minimum in the agreements with NHK, JBA and others
